instance_id.description: (Required) The ID of the existing PolarDBX instance on which the super account will be created. This module does NOT create instances - only manages the super account for existing ones.

i18n.zh-Hans: （必填）将在其上创建高权限账号的现有PolarDB-X实例的ID。本模块不创建实例，仅管理现有实例的高权限账号。
i18n.en-US: (Required) The ID of the existing PolarDB-X instance on which the super account will be created. This module does NOT create instances - only manages the super account for existing ones.

super_account.description: Super account configuration. Set to null to skip creating the super account. The security account group (name/password) and the audit account group (name/password) must be provided together - either both or neither.
super_account.type:
object({
    admin_account_name           = string
    admin_account_password       = string
    admin_account_description    = optional(string, "")
    security_account_name        = optional(string)
    security_account_password    = optional(string)
    security_account_description = optional(string, "")
    audit_account_name           = optional(string)
    audit_account_password       = optional(string)
    audit_account_description    = optional(string)
  })

i18n.zh-Hans: 高权限账号配置。设为 null 则跳过高权限账号的创建。安全账号组（名称/密码）与审计账号组（名称/密码）必须同时提供——要么都配置，要么都不配置。
i18n.en-US: Super account configuration. Set to null to skip creating the super account. The security account group (name/password) and the audit account group (name/password) must be provided together - either both or neither.
